name: Zhe Jin Zhi
overview:
After giving birth to the son of Prince Xie Yan Huo, maidservant Su Wan Qiao and her child were both cruelly killed by Princess Consort Ruan Xi Yin.

Reborn into a new life, Su Wan Qiao vows to live for herself — to resist injustice, overturn the prince’s household, and personally take revenge on her enemies.
